result.summary: The page is largely intact; the clipped carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior. One minor issue remains: the top-right profile control is nearly invisible against the white background.

issues.description: The circular profile/avatar button in the top-right is a very light gray circle on a white background, giving it extremely low contrast so it is hard to perceive as a tappable control; only the small red notification dot stands out.
issues.suggestion: Increase the circle's contrast with a darker fill, a visible border, or a person icon so the control is clearly distinguishable from the background.
